home.approach_title: Treating the whole person, not just the symptom
home.approach_text: We look at the root causes of your complaint: your work and home stress, overall body condition, nutrition, posture and the patterns held in your muscles. That is how we help you recover quickly and keep the result.
home.meet_text: Mellany graduated as a physiotherapist in 2017 and, three years later, as a registered nurse. She is fluent in English, Dutch and Spanish. "I chose this career because I wanted to help people have the best quality of life, whatever their situation."
home.area_text: We come to your home in and around Rojales. Not sure whether we cover your address? Send us your town and we will let you know.
home.final_title: Have a question about your complaint?

services.title: Treatments
services.description: Manual therapy, work injuries and sport injuries: physiotherapy at home on the Costa Blanca by PhysioFit365.
services.intro: Every treatment starts with a thorough assessment and ends with a plan you can follow on your own, so you take an active part in your recovery.

items.title: Manual therapy
items.short: Hands-on treatment to improve movement, reduce pain and restore function.
items.body: Manual therapy is one of our core services. Together we work on your movement potential and on a healthier, fuller way of life. Your therapist carries out a comprehensive assessment, including posture and biomechanics, to find the cause of your problem. When you are ready for discharge you receive a personal home exercise programme so you stay healthy.

items.title: Work injuries
items.short: Rehabilitation to get you safely back to work.
items.body: If an injury at work is holding you back, our work injury programme takes an active yet careful approach to getting you back to work. We take a team approach and will consult with your employer and case manager if necessary, and we help you return to all normal functional activities.

items.title: Sport injuries
items.short: Assessment, treatment and prevention for athletes of every level.
items.body: We focus our rehabilitation on the performance needs of athletes as well as on preventing sport-related injuries. Your first appointment includes questions about your sport and possibly a few movements to demonstrate. Your diagnosis and treatment plan are then discussed together. We assess, treat and rehabilitate musculoskeletal and soft tissue injuries.

how.title: You get in touch
how.text: Send a message or call. Tell us briefly what is going on.

how.title: Assessment at home
how.text: We visit you, listen carefully and assess your complaint. A session usually takes 45 to 60 minutes.

how.title: Treatment and plan
how.text: You receive hands-on treatment and a clear plan with exercises you can do yourself.

services.cta_text: Describe your complaint and we will advise you.

about.title: About PhysioFit365
about.description: Meet Mellany Ginny van Hoeven, physiotherapist and registered nurse, and learn how PhysioFit365 works.
about.intro: PhysioFit365 offers physiotherapy at home on the Costa Blanca, combining traditional physiotherapy with modern manual therapy.
about.philosophy: Therapy works best when people are treated as whole human beings, not as separate body parts. We look for the root causes of your complaint and treat those.
about.vision: To be a practice that attracts, rewards and keeps highly skilled physiotherapy staff, and that keeps developing effective treatment methods.
about.mission: As primary healthcare professionals we help our clients resume their lifelong pursuit of health, fitness and well-being.
about.quality: We take a goal-oriented approach to healing. Whatever your goals are, we want to help you achieve them.
about.care: Hands-on treatment plus the education you take home with you, so you become an active participant in your recovery and future health.
about.mellany_intro: Mellany started PhysioFit365 in 2020 to create a practice that combines the best of traditional physiotherapy with the latest principles and techniques of manual therapy.
about.education: Mellany graduated as a physiotherapist from UCH CEU University in Elche (Spain) in 2017. Three years later she also graduated as a fully registered nurse. She has a special interest in manual therapy and sport rehabilitation.
about.registration: Illustrious Official College of Physiotherapists of the Valencian Community, number 6048.
about.career: During her seven years at university, Mellany worked as a physiotherapist in various public and private hospitals, as well as in private practices, institutes and government rehabilitation centres.
quals: Graduate diploma in physiotherapy (4-year university programme)
Graduate diploma in nursing (4-year programme, completed in 3 years)

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Answers to common questions about physiotherapy and home visits by PhysioFit365.

items.a: Physiotherapists are university-trained experts in diagnosing and treating injuries, prescribing exercise, preventing injury and rehabilitation, across many areas of sport, health and fitness.
Yes. PhysioFit365 works with professionals who have advanced training in manual therapy, sport therapy, work-related therapy and other disciplines.

items.q: Do you really treat at home?
items.a: Yes. We come to you in and around Rojales. Treating you in your own surroundings is more comfortable, and a session usually lasts 45 to 60 minutes, sometimes shorter or longer.
Mellany speaks English, Dutch and Spanish, so you can describe your complaint in the language you are most comfortable with.
Common reasons are pain, recovery after surgery, muscle strengthening, work-related injuries and sport injuries. Not sure? Send us a message and we will advise you.

items.q: How do I get in touch?
items.a: Use the contact form, call us or email info@physiofit365.com. We are available Monday to Friday, 15:00 to 21:00.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How PhysioFit365 handles the personal data you send through this website.
privacy.draft: This text is a draft and should be reviewed before publication.

sections.p: PhysioFit365, Mellany Ginny van Hoeven, Calle Agata Buzón 77, 03170 Rojales (Alicante), Spain. Email: info@physiofit365.com.

Only what you enter in the contact form: name, email, phone number, town or area, the subject of your question, your message, whether you prefer an answer by phone or email, and the language of the page you used. We also store the time of your request.
To answer your question and, if you wish, to arrange a home visit. We rely on your consent, which you give by ticking the box before sending the form.

Requests are stored in a database hosted in the European Union. Only PhysioFit365 can read them. We do not sell or share your data for marketing. When you submit the form, a notification email is also sent to PhysioFit365 through an email delivery service (Resend).
No longer than needed to deal with your request and any follow-up care.

You can ask us at any time to access, correct or delete your data, or withdraw your consent, by emailing info@physiofit365.com. You can also lodge a complaint with the Spanish data protection authority (AEPD).
This website does not use tracking or advertising cookies.
